# Speedway 146

> Outdoor go-kart racing, bounce houses and party rooms at 6750 TX-146 in
> Baytown, Texas. Open Friday through Sunday, walk-ins welcome, karts run in
> five-minute heats with kids and adults raced separately.

Booking is online or at the gate. Every racer signs a waiver in person and
brings valid ID. Party packages include the private room and wristbands that
rotate among guests.

For November 2026 only the gate also opens on Thursday, and go-kart rides are
$5 plus tax every Thursday and Friday that month from 5:00 PM to 10:30 PM. The
standing week is Friday through Sunday.

## Pages

- [Home](https://baytowngokarts.com/): the track, what is on this weekend, and the November $5 ride nights.
- [Pricing](https://baytowngokarts.com/pricing): race prices, wristbands, group rates and party packages.
- [Events and parties](https://baytowngokarts.com/events): birthdays, corporate outings and how a booked party runs.
- [About](https://baytowngokarts.com/about): the venue, the karts and the safety rules.
- [FAQ](https://baytowngokarts.com/faq): height and age limits, what to wear, heat length, outside food.
- [Contact](https://baytowngokarts.com/contact): phone, email, address, opening hours and directions.
